verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Bolna records calls and lets users listen to recordings, and it offers Indian data residency and self-hosting. None of this documents a per-call recording on/off control, consent or disclosure handling, or configurable retention periods. Having recordings, data residency and self-hosting are adjacent features, not the compliance controls this story asks for.

support.subject: As a founder, I can meet call-recording consent and disclosure obligations with per-call recording controls and configurable data retention
